snippet.title: Wanted: Weapons of Fate Launch Trailer
snippet.description: As you probably know, Universals Wanted: Weapons of Fate launches tomorrow.  In honor of its junk-stabbing goodness, we proudly present to you the Wanted Launch Trailer, which is available for your enjoyment today!
